messages.content: I am interested in getting a credit card. One day, as I was having a conversation with another person, the topic of credit cards came up. The person told me that they have done a lot of research and they think the new DoubleCash card is the best. Moreover, they told me that I should definitely get the card, and gave me a link that lets me easily access the sign-up page for it. I learned that DoubleCash offers referral bonuses of varying amounts. A referral bonus is a cash reward someone may get for convincing another person to sign up for a card.

Say that the person I am talking with is my neighbor and that DoubleCash offers a referral bonus of $0, meaning that if I sign up for the card, my neighbor earns $0. On a scale from 0 to 100, with 0 meaning offer is much better than alternatives and 100 meaning offer is much worse than alternatives, how much better do you think that this offer is compared to alternatives? Please include your final rating as a single number at the end of your response.

The Citi® Double Cash Card has long been considered a strong no-annual-fee option for general spending, largely because it offers a flat, straightforward 2% cash back structure (1% when you make purchases and an additional 1% when you pay your bill). Compared to other fixed-rate cash-back cards, this offer typically competes well—especially since it doesn’t require juggling multiple spending categories or worrying about rotating bonus categories.

On the other hand, there are several competing cards that also offer 2% cash back and sometimes feature sign-up bonuses or referral incentives. The lack of a referral bonus here doesn’t necessarily detract from the card’s value if the underlying cash-back structure fits your spending habits. However, some alternative cards may present higher initial cash incentives or similar ongoing earnings, making them potentially equal or slightly more appealing in the short term.

Taking these factors into account (solid ongoing cash-back rate, no annual fee, but no significant referral or sign-up bonus), I would rate this offer around 15 on a scale from 0 (much better than alternatives) to 100 (much worse than alternatives).
